1. About the App and Its Open-Source License

BiliPai is an open-source third-party client for Bilibili, released under the GNU GPL v3. Its source code is publicly available in the project repository at https://github.com/jay3-yy/BiliPai. This app is not affiliated with, partnered with, or authorized by Shanghai Hode Information Technology Co., Ltd. (Bilibili). Bilibili and related names and marks remain the property of their respective owners. This app is provided “as is” under the terms of GPL v3. Subject to GPL v3, you may use, modify, and redistribute it. Except as expressly stated in GPL v3, this app comes with no express or implied warranties. By continuing to use the app, you accept both this agreement and the GPL v3 license.

This app is completely free. It must not be sold, offered as a paid download, bundled for a fee, or distributed for profit through any channel. Anyone may obtain the complete source code from the project repository at no charge under GPL v3. If you paid to obtain this app, you may have been resold it improperly. Do not trust such commercial claims; you can report the seller through the project repository.
2. Privacy and Data Handling
1. The app does not operate developer-owned servers and does not collect or upload your identity information, browsing history, or login credentials.

2. Login credentials (including cookies issued by Bilibili after login, such as SESSDATA and bili_jct, and access tokens) are stored only on your device using system-provided encryption. They are deleted when you uninstall the app and are never provided to third parties.

3. Network requests made while using the app, including video streams, danmaku, comments, and user information, are sent directly from your device to official Bilibili interfaces. Their content and frequency depend on how you use the app. Bilibili\'s own privacy policy applies to its handling of the data you request.

4. The app integrates Google Firebase for quality monitoring: crash reports (Firebase Crashlytics, including crash stacks, device model, and system version) and anonymized usage statistics (Firebase Analytics, such as daily activity, page views, basic feature events, app version, and language/region). These do not include your account ID, phone number, or other identity information. This data is sent to Google\'s Firebase servers. You can turn off each collection category separately using the “Crash Tracking” and “Usage Statistics” switches in Settings.

5. Transfers between devices (including login sessions, settings, and plugin QR-code transfers) use end-to-end encryption. Content is encrypted and decrypted only on the two devices and does not pass through a server. Use this feature only between devices you trust.

6. Your phone number, SMS verification code, and account password are submitted in encrypted form directly to Bilibili\'s official login interface only when you choose to log in. The app does not record, store, or upload them. After login, session credentials are stored locally as described in item 2. Bilibili sends verification messages; the app does not use them for any other purpose.
3. QR-Code Login and Account Risks

1. QR-code login (including TV QR codes) and QR-code authorization (confirming a login request from a web page or TV) grant the relevant device access to your Bilibili account. Make sure the requesting device belongs to you or someone you trust, and check the login location and device details before authorizing.

2. Bilibili does not officially support access to its interfaces by third-party clients, and such use may conflict with its user agreement or terms of service. Logging in through this app may expose your account to risk controls, restricted features, or suspension. You are responsible for assessing and accepting these risks.
3. Scanning an unknown QR code may grant an attacker access to your account and result in account theft. Do not scan QR codes from untrusted sources.
4. User Conduct and Responsibility
1. Follow the laws and regulations in your region and Bilibili\'s user agreement. Do not use this app for unlawful or infringing activity.
2. Minors should use this app under a guardian\'s guidance.
3. This app is for learning, discussion, and personal use. You are responsible for all consequences arising from your use of it.
5. Effective Date and Changes

This agreement takes effect when you accept it on your first launch of the app. The developer may revise, supplement, or update it at any time due to changes in laws or regulations, product updates, or operational needs. Updated terms will be released with an app version and shown in the app; you will be asked to accept them again. If you do not agree to an update, stop using the app and uninstall it. Continuing to use the app after an update means you accept the revised agreement. Please review this agreement periodically for the latest terms.
